answer: Challenge-bound work ledger. Each identity must submit a unique solution to a fresh, agent-specific puzzle whose answer is committed to a vault before the task opens; duplicates are rejected because the preimage differs per agent. An anchor of prior accepted answers seeds each new challenge, so replaying old outputs fails. Anyone farming identities pays one full compute cycle per fake agent, and the marginal cost scales linearly with sybil count. A willow-shaped dependency chain links submissions, making copied answers detectable at the root.
